/bookingTrustItems/0/body.source_en: Built around the Busan cruise port-call clock — 08:30 pickup at the cruise terminal, 19:15 return with a 30–60 min reboarding buffer for the standard 19:30+ sail-away. Not missed a sail-away in 4 seasons of operation.

/bookingTrustItems/1/body.source_en: Licensed Busan tour provider with certified English-speaking guides, vehicle insurance, and route timing tested against the busiest cruise-port-call days of the year (peak season Apr–May and Sep–Nov).

/bookingTrustItems/2/body.source_en: All eight main-stop admissions are included in the tour price (free attractions). Optional add-ons (cable car, tower observatory) are clearly listed and never bundled into the headline price.

/seasonalVariations/0/description.source_en: Cherry blossoms along the Songdo coast and the Gamcheon village approach in late March / early April. Busan's blossom timing is 7–10 days ahead of Seoul. Buddha's Birthday (May) brings the Yeondunhoe lantern festival at Yonggungsa.

/seasonalVariations/1/description.source_en: Long daylight; coastal stops (Yonggungsa, Songdo, Gamcheon) stay cooler than inland. July monsoon may shorten outdoor time. Yonggungsa morning visit avoids heat. ⟦G0⟧ Festival runs June–August with sand-sculpture displays.

/seasonalVariations/2/description.source_en: Clearest visibility, warmest sea — best season overall. Foliage in late October. Cheongsapo / Gamcheon golden hour most comfortable. November 11 'Turn Toward Busan' ceremony at UN Cemetery is a notable cultural event.

/seasonalVariations/3/description.source_en: Fewer crowds; clear sea views; mild for Korea (Busan winter lows 5–10 °C). Yonggungsa New Year's Day sunrise is a major event. Yongdusan Citizens' Bell strikes 33 times on New Year's Eve.

/bookingSupportSteps/2/description.source_en: Coach plate, guide name, and meeting-point photo sent 30 min before the 08:30 pickup so you know exactly who to find when you disembark.

/bookingSupportSteps/3/description.source_en: Guide provides on-site narration on Yonggungsa's 1376 founding, UNMCK's 22-nation story, Gamcheon's 1955 refugee settlement, Songdo's 1913 opening, and Yongdusan's Dabotap heritage.

/bookingSupportSteps/4/detail.source_en: Direct return to cruise terminal coach lot

/bookingSupportSteps/4/description.source_en: Coach returns guests to the cruise terminal coach lot by approximately 19:15–19:30 with a 30–60 min reboarding buffer.

/bookingSupportSteps/5/description.source_en: Post-tour feedback request sent; questions about Korean recipes or Busan attractions answered for guests heading on to other Korea ports.
